participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Dreamy and passionate about music, determined to overcome obstacles.
participant_1.background: I play the piano and guitar and sing. My parents aren't very supportive of my dream. I also work as a custodian to help pay the bills. My favorite type of music to sing is folk music. I am a musician and hope to make it big someday.

participant_2.name: Leonardo
participant_2.personality: Creative and adventurous, with a love for cooking and travel.
participant_2.background: I am a descendant of Christopher Columbus. I am an art major in college. I love to cook paella. I have a weakness for fish and chips. I visit Europe twice a year.
